world: Each post is one episode of The Greek Hour: a real night in Aventura or Sunny Isles that slips into a Greek fantasy. Stone, olive, sea light, linen, deep blue, warm white. A person is mid-gesture. The frozen yogurt is why the myth showed up, seen inside the life. News can spark the episode. The post is a story with a turn, never a catalog photo of a cup and never three similar portraits.
imagePosts: Carousels of 3 or 4 slides. Slide 1 is the strange beautiful hook. The middle slide turns it. The last slide places the real logo inside that same world. One caption.
videoPosts: One 15 second vertical episode with fast cuts and a surprise in the first second. No logo and no words.
rules: Open these files before writing a post.
Brand references are logo, cart, uniforms, and toppings.
The opening is Aventura and Sunny Isles.
Use the week's frozen yogurt idea only as a spark, then set it inside this Greek lifestyle.
Every post invites someone to step into the scene and try the yogurt.
Write the episode before the prompts. The slides have to change. A quiet portrait from a new angle is not a carousel.
The caption opens with one line a person would say out loud, then invites them to come try it.
Match the blue, white, olive, and thick white yogurt.
The cart is optional. Use it only for a shop episode.
Image posts are carousels. Put the real logo on the last slide only, copied from the logo file.
Do not ask the video model to draw the logo or the word Títi.
Do not name other frozen yogurt brands.

images.shows: Circular blue logo. Olive branch, Títi script, Greek frozen yogurt, Greek key.
White and deep-blue frozen yogurt cart with olive branches, a topping case, and palms. Sign reads Sunny Isles.
Opening uniforms: deep-blue apron, cream hoodie, cream t-shirt, two-tone cap, blue sweatpants, all with the olive logo.
Topping bar. Ceramic bowls, pink crumble, chocolate, nuts, wooden spoons, blue and white.
